category_title: Actively engaged students with severe disabilities in large-group instruction
scenario_title: Passive engagement and physical support during carpet time
minimal_context: The student is sitting on a small wooden chair on the carpet with peers, listening to the teacher read a story about the water cycle.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: It is time for our group instruction. Please come to the carpet so I can read a story about the water cycle.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Selects a fidget item from the bin and sits down in a small wooden chair on the carpet to be at the same level as the other students.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: I am going to start reading now. 'The sun warms the water in the ocean, and it turns into invisible vapor that floats up into the sky.'

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Sits on the carpet surrounded by peers, quietly listening to the teacher read the story.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: 'The vapor gets cold and turns into clouds.' What do you all think happens next?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Exhibits passive engagement during the whole-group read-aloud activity, simply watching the teacher without responding to the question.)

task.content: Listening to a teacher read a story about the water cycle.

context.environment: Early elementary classroom, on the carpet
context.materials: Small wooden chair, variety of fidget items
context.social_setting: Surrounded by peers during group instruction

behavior_patterns.condition: During lecture activities, whole-group read-aloud activities, and watching other students complete a task
